description: Plain 30 × 20 × 10 mm block with 0° draft on all side walls. Casting and injection moulding require positive draft (typically ≥ 1°). The casting/moulding analyzer is wired in via brep_dfm_rules.py and tested directly in test_brep_dfm_rules.py — the printing/CNC analyzers shouldn't fire on this clean block.
